playbook.note: No uk file exists for the Playbooks plugin. Existing webapp strings keep English 'Playbook' inline and mobile once uses 'Плейбуків'; the declinable transliteration 'плейбук' (masculine, genitive 'плейбука') reads more naturally in running text.

run.note: Noun = one execution of a playbook: 'запуск', plural 'запуски'. Verb 'Run playbook' = 'Запустити плейбук' (grounded in webapp: 'Запустити playbooks').

task.note: Neuter; identical singular/plural nominative. Grounded in mobile.

status update.note: 'Post update' = 'Опублікувати оновлення' (mobile renders it 'Оновлення допису', which misreads the English — avoid).

follower.note: Person receiving updates without participating; 'Follow/Unfollow' buttons follow the core glossary ('стежити' / 'припинити стежити').

metric.note: Feminine. Grounded: 'Метрика навантаження' in webapp admin strings.

overdue.note: 'Update overdue' = 'Оновлення прострочено'. Mobile's 'Оновлення запізнилося' is a looser variant.

due date.note: Mobile renders the field label as 'Термін до'; 'No due date' = 'Без терміну виконання'.

timeline.note: The chronological event record of a run; 'часова шкала' would suggest a scrubber UI.

assignee.note: Mobile's existing 'Правонаступник' (legal successor) is a mistranslation — do not reuse it.

attribute.note: Same rendering as user profile attributes in core; context distinguishes playbook property fields.

run summary.note: This is the run's editable description, so 'опис' fits better than 'підсумок' (reserved for AI/meeting summaries).
